title: Cucuto shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the pack, bundle, repository and backup schemas. Patterns are anchored and use only syntax that behaves the same in ECMAScript, Java and Kotlin regular expressions.

packId.description: Globally unique pack or bundle ID in reverse-domain form, lowercase: at least two dot-separated labels of [a-z0-9-], each starting and ending with a letter or digit. Use a domain you control, or io.github.<user>.

slug.description: Lowercase ID unique within its parent: words of [a-z0-9] joined by single hyphens.

version.description: Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release suffix. Build metadata (+...) is not allowed. Compared by SemVer 2.0.0 precedence.

name.description: Human-readable name; must contain a non-space character.

license.description: An SPDX license expression (for example CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0 or 'MIT OR Apache-2.0') or, if none applies, free text such as 'Personal use only'. Free text produces the LICENSE_NOT_SPDX warning.

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the pack or bundle. Segments use [A-Za-z0-9._-], never start with '.' or '-', and are separated by single slashes. Absolute paths, '.' and '..' segments and backslashes are impossible by construction.

urlReference.description: Absolute https URL, or a relative reference resolved against the URL of the document that contains it (RFC 3986). Other schemes and protocol-relative references (//host) are not allowed.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, for example 2026-10-23T18:30:00Z.

extensions.description: Keys starting with x- are reserved for experiments and tools; readers ignore them.
